Come join our amazing team and work remote from home!

The Investor Reporting Analyst is responsible for generating various monthly accounting reports for assigned investors, analyzing results and ensuring accurate and timely completion of required reports and compliance with investor guidelines. The target pay range for this position is $31.00-$36.00 per hour.

What you’ll do:

  • Forecasts principal and interest advance for the securitization on monthly basis, using specified pooling and servicing agreement; ensures that reports are prepared within the timeframes and other terms established in the servicing agreement.
  • Creates and distributes monthly loan-level remittance reports to appropriate trustee, including the Loan Modification Report, REO Liquidation Gains and Losses, and Stop Advancing Report.
  • Remits funds to investors to meet servicing agreements by preparing wire transfers.
  • Reviews the pool to security reconciliation for discrepancies of loans to make the necessary corrections.
  • Analyzes remittance differences between investor accounting reports and remittance reports to maintain cash in custodial account.
  • Validates data coming from other departments and works with those departments to resolve any discrepancies, e.g., modification reports and liquidation reports.

What you’ll need:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred.
  • Schedule/schedule experience preferred.
  • GNMA experience as well as Mortgage Backed Securities experience preferred.

  • One (1) to two (2) years of related experience, including investor accounting and reporting, required.

Our Company:

Carrington Mortgage Services is part of The Carrington Companies, which provide integrated, full-lifecycle mortgage loan servicing assistance to borrowers and investors, delivering exceptional customer care and programs that support borrowers and their homeownership experience. We hope you’ll consider joining our growing team of uniquely talented professionals as we transform residential real estate. To read more visit: .

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive healthcare plans for you and your family. Plus, a discretionary 401(k) match of 50% of the first 4% of pay contributed.
  • Access to several fitness, restaurant, retail (and more!) discounts through our employee portal.
  • Customized training programs to help you advance your career.
  • Employee referral bonuses so you’ll get paid to help Carrington and Vylla grow.
  • Educational Reimbursement.
  • Carrington Charitable Foundation contributes to the community through causes that reflect the interests of Carrington Associates. For more information about Carrington Charitable Foundation, and the organizations and programs, it supports through specific fundraising efforts, please visit: carringtoncf.org.

raw.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Go-To-Market Engineer in our New Markets area in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

In this role, you will sit at the strategic intersection of Demand Generation, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Technical teams. As an operational amplifier for our commercial organization, you will design, build, and optimize AI-powered automations, automated workflows, and data pipelines that power our outbound go-to-market motions and help Wellhub scale globally.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Automate GTM Infrastructure: Design and deploy AI-powered data enrichment systems and workflows (using tools like Clay, Zapier, n8n, Salesforce, and Salesloft) to identify Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) prospects and deliver high-intent leads directly to sales teams.
  • Drive Commercial Personalization: Build workflows that automate highly personalized messaging and deliver actionable account intelligence to SDRs and Closers to increase conversion rates.
  • Execute GTM Experiments: Drive, prioritize, and analyze A/B experiments and outbound pilots to accelerate regional pipeline generation and remove operational bottlenecks.
  • Act as Internal Operational Expert: Serve as the subject matter expert and day-to-day operator for Clay, Salesloft, and Salesforce across your designated region.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Partner closely with Global Strategy, Sales Dev Directors, Marketing, and Revenue Ops leaders to track funnel performance, synthesize feedback loops, and influence regional commercial strategy.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across international teams.
  • Technical Curiosity & Vibe Coding: Passionate about learning new tools, experimenting with AI tools (like Claude, Cursor, or AI Agents), and tinkering with automation platforms.
  • Relevant Experience: Proven track record in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Technical Product Management, or Project Management managing complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives.
  • Systems & Tooling Familiarity: Experience building workflows and automations using CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot), sales engagement tools (Salesloft, Apollo), or orchestration platforms (Clay, n8n, Zapier, Make).
  • Commercial Bias & ROI Mindset: Relentlessly focused on practical outcomes—always asking "how will this workflow help an SDR validate more opportunities or close more deals?"
  • Experimental & Analytical: Comfortable testing hypotheses, analyzing data (SQL/Excel), validating signals, and navigating ambiguous requirements into structured, scalable processes.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that AI Tools expertise and Fluent English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhuband LinkedIn!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.

Customer Success Manager

Bluecore | Customer Success | Full-time

About the Role

Bluecore is looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to own the day-to-day health and performance of a portfolio of retail and direct-to-consumer brands. As the primary point of contact for your clients, you will act as a trusted extension of their marketing team: analyzing performance, surfacing insights, and driving action that keeps programs winning against their goal. This is a client-facing role for someone who is analytical, organized, and energized by helping retailers grow through the Bluecore platform.

What You'll Do

  • Own program performance for your accounts, summarizing daily, weekly, monthly, and year-over-year results and clearly explaining wins and losses versus plan.
  • Analyze how key inputs (traffic, events, CTR, CVR, and more) impact performance, and translate the data into insights that drive client action.
  • Communicate insights and recommendations to client marketing stakeholders, and guide how hypotheses are tested to prove or disprove what is affecting performance.
  • Run primary diagnostics before escalating, using Bluecore, Looker, and Google Sheets to isolate when and why performance changed.
  • Take ownership of the client program by proactively setting alignment meetings, documenting outcomes, and driving follow-up to close action items.
  • Monitor account performance against last year and against goals, and plan the right actions to support renewals and upsell.
  • Collaborate across your squad and supporting teams, sharing timely updates and proactively asking for help when needed.
  • Build strong relationships with client stakeholders so you are seen as a genuine extension of their team.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience working with or for retailers, or a strong understanding of the retail and e-commerce landscape.
  • Comfort operating in analytics tools such as Bluecore, Excel or Google Sheets, and the ability to build performance narratives from data.
  • Strong communication and active-listening skills, with the ability to read back key points with both operational and business-level stakeholders.
  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset: you probe the right sources, weigh alternatives, and ask for support when appropriate.
  • A collaborative, accountable approach and the flexibility to stay positive through change.
  • Baseline familiarity with commercial fundamentals such as contract timelines and consumption, and how performance can affect renewal or upsell.

Why Bluecore

Bluecore is a retail marketing platform that helps the world's fastest-growing brands turn shopper data into personalized, revenue-driving campaigns. As a CSM, you will sit at the intersection of data, strategy, and relationships, with a clear path to grow into senior and leadership roles across our Customer Success organization.

ABOUT US:

AirFind is an innovative product and services company that provides monetization and mobile advertising solutions to wireless carriers, web and app publishers, network providers and app developers. Through AirFind’s extensive partner network we deliver custom solutions that meet our clients’ unique business needs. Our private-label ad monetization technology and partner branded content experiences drive higher user retention and more engaging user experiences.

POSITION SUMMARY:

We are looking for a Product Owner to help manage our suite of Android and iOS Apps. The main focus of this role will be managing and expanding our portfolio of private label Apps to additional markets and some of the largest Telcos in the world. In addition to helping manage our business relationship the PO will be responsible for the typical PO job responsibilities.

The Product Owner will interact with our customers and partners to understand user problems, obtain feedback on existing products and competitive products, and identify solutions. You will synthesize these inputs into roadmaps and product requirements and socialize these with internal and external stakeholders. While managing our clients is a major focus of this role, there will be room to define creative solutions. Devising creative solutions to help monetize our apps, and conduct A/B tests to test your hypothesis will be core to this role’s success. This is a wonderful opportunity to apply your creativity and skills and hit the ground running using previous industry experience, which is why previous experience in ad tech, mobile app development and app monetization are required.

Our ideal Product Owner will have demonstrated experience working with engineers and designers to deliver engaging In-App user experiences, as well as success defining and conducting A/B experiments that optimize engagement and conversions. Experience with rewarded and/or lock screen apps is a plus.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The ideal candidate will have relevant experience that sets them up for success and enable them to grow into the role of a strategic leader and have influence on the larger Airfind App strategy. Successes can be leveraged to our other clients and O&O Apps, and the broader Airfind business.

This is a hands-on position, which will require the following capabilities:

  • Act as a subject matter expert for projects under management; driving engagement and optimizing user conversions. Drive innovation and early adoption of industry trends to better monetize our App suite; accountable for portfolio P/L
  • Own and maintain a portfolio of Airfind private labels as designated
  • Lead the definition and development of new apps through the various stages of requirements gathering, UX/UI design, App development and launch
  • Conduct A/B experiments determining the most effective calls-to-action and, when applicable, define the optimal rewards and redemption model that keeps users engaged while maximizing revenue
  • Work closely with the Engineering, Yield Optimization, Operations and Product teams to ensure we have the right capabilities and functionality to achieve our corporate goals; proactively monitor and propose optimizations to our monetization strategy or App UX
  • Develop product roadmaps and business plans for your product lines; using data and customer feedback to define and prioritize product requirements, features and functionality
  • Be the lead Product Owner for one or more agile development teams; gathering requirements and navigating product development through all Agile ceremonies
  • Act as the ambassador between business needs and the technology group, by translating business needs into structured user stories as actionable units of work for multiple technology teams
  • Monitor and react to product KPIs by analyzing behavioral and objective user data. Strategically identify unmet consumer needs and opportunities; effectively utilize metrics to demonstrate problems and indicate success leveraging A/B tests and yield optimization analysis
  • Triage requests for new product functionality as needed by evaluating their value to the customer and business
  • Hands-on project management to lead product design, development, and release process for assigned products; tight collaboration with Product Marketing to ensure smooth product launches
  • Support marketing, sales, and support efforts by leading the development and maintenance of appropriate collateral including user guides, presentations, and marketing content
  • Develop hands-on, in-depth knowledge of competitive products and maintain technical analysis of competitive strengths and weaknesses

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Airfind is remote first but the PO must have the ability to travel to our client’s offices (potentially outside the US).
  • Ability to work hands-on within fast-moving organization; thrive with ambiguity and comfortable with fluid processes
  • 5 or more years of experience as a hands-on product owner/manager, or similar role owning multiple Apps; strong preference for candidates with previous ad tech monetization experience working with rewarded platforms, demand partners
  • High familiarity with Admob, Meta and other native monetization platforms
  • Previous experience working with pre-loaded Apps, GSM certification and other related nuances of support Telcos.
  • Robust knowledge of Android, iOS, and Flutter Apps, App development and related best practices (UX, App/Play Store policies) is required
  • Experience defining and conducting A/B tests to optimize yield, click-through-rates and other conversion metrics. Ability to synthesize results and recommend plans of action to a cross functional team; support with data.
  • Experience with ad-tech and familiarity with rewarded experiences is highly desirable. Familiarity with search, display and display-to-search monetization strategies a bonus
  • Demonstrated command of the principles of Agile methodologies; success leading Agile teams as a hands-on product owner
  • Ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders, clients and partners
  • Knowledge of analytical tools (Google Analytics, Firebase, Excel/Sheets, MixPanel, Looker Studio, etc.)
  • The ability to make impossible deadlines while keeping a good sense of humor is a huge plus

raw.title: Principal Software Engineer, Data
raw.excerpt: Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care.
raw.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join our Datastore team. The Datastore sits at the heart of Beacon's platform. It defines our foundational data model and serves as the centralized repository and API for brain data collected from clinical studies, supporting the analytical tools, services, and applications used by our scientists, clinicians, and partners.

This role emphasizes the architecture and design of solutions spanning the Beacon Platform, with a focus on scalable data models to serve expanding business needs, event-driven pipelines, and engineering best practices. You will coach engineers and stakeholders of the Datastore on design patterns, collaborate with product and technical leads across platform and scientific teams, and help shape architectural direction and standards across Platform teams.

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs available located in Boston, New York and Paris. This role is fully remote working anywhere in the US.

What success looks like

  • You partner with engineering and product leaders and Datastore stakeholders to guide architecture and solutions for the Beacon Datastore, and influence architectural standards across Platform teams
  • You implement features that model best practices, and coach team members to develop their skills. You hold the Datastore to ever higher standards for data integrity, design soundness, and maintainability as it grows
  • You draft RFCs to lead complex feature discovery and technical design phases, soliciting and incorporating input and building alignment on the decisions that guide development

What you will bring

  • 10+ years of backend development experience, including significant experience focused on data engineering, data platforms, and infrastructure for data-centric applications
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, with production experience working with PostgreSQL
  • Proficiency with data streaming and event processing, using tools such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pulsar, or a cloud-based equivalent like Amazon Kinesis
  • Strong proficiency in a modern general-purpose language; proficiency in the Datastore's specific stack (SQL/TypeScript/Julia) is not required, but you should be able and excited to learn quickly!
  • Experience with, or interest in, using LLM-assisted or agentic coding tools in a production setting, with good judgment about what guardrails are needed
  • Experience deploying and operating services in containerized environments, with familiarity in Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and/or Helm
  • A collaborative mindset - you enjoy working across disciplines and believe people achieve more together than alone
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous and remote-friendly environments

We don't expect every candidate to check every box. If you bring strong fundamentals, care about data infrastructure for health, and are excited to learn, we’d love to hear from you!

The salary range for this role is $190,000 – $210,000. Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location.The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

raw.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join our Datastore team. The Datastore sits at the heart of Beacon's platform. It defines our foundational data model and serves as the centralized repository and API for brain data collected from clinical studies, supporting the analytical tools, services, and applications used by our scientists, clinicians, and partners.

This role emphasizes the architecture and design of solutions spanning the Beacon Platform, with a focus on scalable data models to serve expanding business needs, event-driven pipelines, and engineering best practices. You will coach engineers and stakeholders of the Datastore on design patterns, collaborate with product and technical leads across platform and scientific teams, and help shape architectural direction and standards across Platform teams.

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs available located in Boston, New York and Paris. This role is fully remote working anywhere in the US.

What success looks like

  • You partner with engineering and product leaders and Datastore stakeholders to guide architecture and solutions for the Beacon Datastore, and influence architectural standards across Platform teams
  • You implement features that model best practices, and coach team members to develop their skills. You hold the Datastore to ever higher standards for data integrity, design soundness, and maintainability as it grows
  • You draft RFCs to lead complex feature discovery and technical design phases, soliciting and incorporating input and building alignment on the decisions that guide development

What you will bring

  • 10+ years of backend development experience, including significant experience focused on data engineering, data platforms, and infrastructure for data-centric applications
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, with production experience working with PostgreSQL
  • Proficiency with data streaming and event processing, using tools such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pulsar, or a cloud-based equivalent like Amazon Kinesis
  • Strong proficiency in a modern general-purpose language; proficiency in the Datastore's specific stack (SQL/TypeScript/Julia) is not required, but you should be able and excited to learn quickly!
  • Experience with, or interest in, using LLM-assisted or agentic coding tools in a production setting, with good judgment about what guardrails are needed
  • Experience deploying and operating services in containerized environments, with familiarity in Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and/or Helm
  • A collaborative mindset - you enjoy working across disciplines and believe people achieve more together than alone
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous and remote-friendly environments

We don't expect every candidate to check every box. If you bring strong fundamentals, care about data infrastructure for health, and are excited to learn, we’d love to hear from you!

The salary range for this role is $190,000 – $210,000. Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location.The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

raw.description:
JSI invites you to join our team as an Instructional Designer/LMS Specialist on our Regulatory Affairs team, where you'll play a critical role in advancing broadband and telecommunications initiatives that expand connectivity and drive digital inclusion—while advancing your career within a mission-driven, growth-focused organization.
About the Company:
JSI is a leading full-service consulting firm specializing in broadband solutions. For over 60 years, we have provided independent communications service providers with expert financial, engineering, management, operational, regulatory, and strategic guidance. Our extensive industry knowledge and proven track record of success have empowered clients to achieve sustainable growth and profitability. With over 750 clients nationwide and a powerful presence in markets like Georgia, Texas, Maryland, and Alaska, JSI empowers rural and regional broadband providers to expand, evolve, and excel in a rapidly shifting digital world.
Position Overview:
Are you a creative instructional designer who loves turning technical, complex material into learning experiences people want to complete? JSI is seeking an Instructional Designer/LMS Specialist to shape how our Regulatory Affairs team educates and engages clients—leading the design of training content, owning our learning platform, and supporting live client-facing events like webinars.
This is fundamentally a content and design role, grounded in the craft of instructional design: structuring information thoughtfully, designing for engagement, and building experiences that make complex subject matter approachable. You'll bring that same design sensibility to our learning platform (JSI University) and to the live webinars we deliver to clients, helping both evolve into more polished, professional experiences.
The ideal candidate has strong instructional design instincts, is comfortable picking up new tools and platforms quickly, and thrives in a role where priorities shift and new needs emerge regularly. Regulatory subject matter expertise is not required—curiosity, creativity, adaptability, and strong design fundamentals matter far more.
As the role matures, it will expand to include broader training strategy, process improvement, and cross-functional support, but instructional design will remain the core of the position.

Responsibilities

  • Instructional Design & Course Development: Lead the design and development of client-facing training, shaping how technical and regulatory content is structured, presented, and experienced. Apply sound instructional design principles to build self-paced courses that are clear, engaging, and effective for a range of learners.
  • Learning Platform Ownership: Own JSI University as the delivery vehicle for the training you build—managing publishing, learner tracking, and day-to-day administration—while continuing to look for ways the platform and the overall learning experience can improve.
  • Process Improvement: Manage and prioritize a diverse and evolving set of projects and tasks supporting regulatory and operational delivery. Adapt quickly to shifting priorities, new tools, and emerging needs while ensuring deliverables are completed accurately and on time through strong organization, attention to detail, and disciplined execution.
  • Webinar & Live Event Support: Support the planning and execution of client-facing webinars, including technical setup, troubleshooting, and quality control during live sessions. Help evolve our webinar program over time, bringing the same attention to engagement and polish that you apply to self-paced courses.
  • Adaptable Project & Priority Management: Manage a diverse and shifting set of projects and tasks in support of the broader Regulatory Affairs team. Comfortably move between priorities, pick up new tools or requests as they arise, and jump in wherever support is needed—maintaining strong organization and follow-through even as the work evolves.
  • Content Strategy & Continuous Improvement: Partner with subject matter experts to identify training needs and priorities and use learner feedback and engagement data to refine existing content over time. This role supports content and engagement but does not carry sales targets or revenue accountability.
  • Team Communication and Collaboration: Maintain clear, timely communication with internal teams and clients. Participate actively in team meetings, contribute creative ideas, and take initiative in shaping how training and client communication is delivered.

Qualifications

Required:
  • Demonstrated experience in instructional design, e-learning development, or a closely related field—whether through professional roles, academic coursework, or a strong portfolio of self-directed projects.
  • Experience with course-authoring tools (Articulate 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, or similar); Articulate 360 experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong instinct for visual and content design—able to look at a dense slide deck or document and reimagine it as something clear, well-organized, and genuinely engaging.
  • Comfort working with or willingness to learn a Learning Management System (LMS) and webinar/live-event software; prior experience with either is a plus but not required.
  • Ability to write clear, concise instructional content, including scripts, on-screen text, knowledge checks, and supporting documentation (SOPs, quick reference guides).
  • Demonstrated ability to manage shifting priorities and a varied workload—comfortable jumping between projects, learning new tools quickly, and adapting as needs evolve.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects at once in a high-volume environment.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong written communication skills.
  • A bachelor's degree in instructional design, education, communications, or a related field is helpful but not required; a strong portfolio or relevant project experience is equally valued.
  • Telecommunications or regulatory experience is not required; ability to quickly learn and translate unfamiliar technical/regulatory material into accessible content is more important.
Preferred:
  • A portfolio demonstrating prior e-learning or interactive course design work (academic, professional, or personal projects welcome).
  • Experience with graphic design or multimedia tools (Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, Vyond, or similar) to support visual course development.
  • Familiarity with adult learning principles and instructional design frameworks (e.g., ADDIE, SAM).
  • Experience with AI-enabled tools or automation for content creation, quality control, or documentation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams), Monday.com, Smartsheets, and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Experience building or prototyping a small application, automation, or integration (e.g., scripting, APIs, no/low-code tools), demonstrating a builder mindset.

Benefits & Compensation

  • Competitive salary + performance-based bonuses.
  • Comprehensive benefits package (medical, dental, vision, 401(k))
  • Generous PTO and wellness opportunities.
  • Ongoing professional development and educational opportunities.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Revenue Tools Product team is responsible for defining the vision, roadmap, and user experience for our core Go-To-Market (GTM) tools to drive seller experience.

As a Sr. Revenue Tools Product Manager, you’ll drive strategy, solve ambiguous and high-impact problems across multiple teams, and influence the long-term strategic direction of our sales technology stack. You will own a significant module of our core GTM tools, delivering substantial impact and contributing significantly to the company’s GTM strategy and future.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management, and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

Fully own the success of your tool(s) within Samsara’s revenue stack.

This includes:

  • Discovery: Lead deep user research to identify, document, and anticipate core seller pain points and future GTM tooling needs.
  • Design: Draft comprehensive Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) and design artifacts (wireframes), ensuring alignment with business goals and automated workflows.
  • Build: Oversee feature execution and drive rigorous usability testing, collaborating with GTMS, Sales Ops, and AI + Data Analytics teams.
  • Launch: Coordinate all aspects of release, including change management, enablement programs, and documentation for seamless field adoption.
  • Adopt & Iterate: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs and adoption metrics) to measure business impact and inform rapid roadmap iterations.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5-8 years of GTM tooling experience in a fast-paced SaaS environment
  • Established subject matter expert in GTM tooling, with a history of delivering substantial impact across multiple tools
  • Ability to translate complex customer and business problems into clear requirements and solutions.
  • Experience with leveraging AI to solve high-impact business problems

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$116,322.50—$175,950 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

About Superhuman, Inc.

Superhuman, Inc. is a nine-figure performance nutrition company entering its next stage of growth. Our portfolio includes Alpha Lion and Superhuman, two distinct brands with different consumers, roles, and opportunities. As the company grows, we intend to build the capability to develop and scale a broader portfolio of differentiated brands.

The Role

Alpha Lion + Super Human have proven product-market fit, built a powerful growth engine, and reached the point where brand can become our next major competitive advantage.

We’re looking for a Director of Brand & Design to help define what Alpha Lion stands for—and then personally make it real. You’ll sharpen our brand strategy alongside leadership, build the identity system around it, and bring that system to life across packaging, DTC, Amazon, retail, and every major product launch.

We are not starting from zero. The foundation exists—products, distribution, and early brand signals are already in market. What we need now is someone who can take what is working, sharpen it into a clear strategic point of view, and elevate it into a cohesive, category-defining brand system. We’re looking for a Director of Brand & Design to help define what Alpha Lion stands for at its highest level—and then personally make it real. You’ll refine and strengthen our brand strategy alongside leadership, translate it into a sharper identity system, and bring that system to life across packaging, DTC, Amazon, retail, and every major product launch.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, design, and commercial impact. The work you do will directly influence how efficiently we acquire customers, how strongly we retain them, and how much pricing power the brand can ultimately command. This is a builder role, not just a brand-management role. You’ll have real authority over how Alpha Lion shows up, but you’ll also stay close to the work. Especially early on, you’ll be working with the team, working through packaging, redesigning touchpoints, and shipping the work that transforms how customers experience Alpha Lion.

The opportunity is to take a brand that already has momentum—and turn it into something unmistakable, coherent, and difficult to copy. A brand that not only looks better, but performs better.

What You’ll Do

  • Define a brand competitors can’t credibly copy. Partner with leadership to sharpen Alpha Lion’s positioning, point of view, identity, boundaries, and tradeoffs—what we stand for, how we win, and what we refuse to become.
  • Turn strategy into something customers can see and feel. Personally lead and execute the evolution of our visual and verbal identity across packaging, DTC, Amazon, retail, product, and launches.
  • Get your hands dirty. This isn't a role where you hand the work to an agency and review it from 30,000 feet. You’ll personally design critical brand work, collaborate with external partners where they make us better, and step into the details whenever quality demands it.
  • Make every touchpoint feel unmistakably Alpha Lion. Create coherence across SKUs and channels so whether someone discovers us on Amazon, sees us on a retail shelf, or opens a package at home, they experience one powerful brand.
  • Own the brand call. Be the company’s authority on brand expression. Give teams clear direction, challenge work that dilutes the brand, and make decisive tradeoffs when speed, commercial needs, and brand integrity collide.
  • Shape how products go to market. Play an active role in product development and GTM, influencing positioning, naming, messaging, packaging, and launch expression before decisions become difficult to change.
  • Build a system that gets stronger as we scale. Create practical guidelines, tools, decision frameworks, and lightweight governance that allow teams to move quickly without turning the brand into a collection of opinions.

What Success Looks Like

  • Our identity is recognizable and coherent across packaging, DTC, Amazon, retail, and launches without becoming repetitive or formulaic.

  • Existing brand assets are not just redesigned—they are up-leveled into a unified system that improves perception, trust, and conversion.

  • Teams make faster, better brand decisions with less confusion and rework because they understand the system and know where the boundaries are.
  • Over time, stronger brand differentiation contributes to improved acquisition efficiency, higher retention, stronger organic demand, customer advocacy, and increased pricing power.

Who you are

You are a design-led brand builder, not a traditional brand marketer who has only worked alongside creative teams, and not a production designer whose range stops at craft. You combine strong design instincts with consumer understanding, commercial judgment, storytelling ability and the leadership required to ship ambitious work through other people.

  • You are passionate about building brands that mean something to people and creating experiences they want to be part of.
  • You move fast. You know when the work needs another round and when it is strong enough to ship, learn and improve.
  • You have high standards without becoming a perfectionist gatekeeper. Your presence creates clarity and momentum rather than bureaucracy.
  • You are proactive. You see gaps, generate ideas and move the right stakeholders toward action without waiting to be pushed.
  • You are evidence-led and low-ego. You can defend a strong point of view, test it against consumer and commercial signals, and change your mind when the evidence warrants it.
  • You understand that Brand and Performance Marketing are complementary. You protect the proposition and brand non-negotiables while enabling channel teams to test and optimize aggressively within them.
  • You can move between strategy, creative direction and execution—zooming out to protect the whole brand and stepping into the work when the moment demands it.

Experience and capabilities

  • 6+ years in brand and design roles within fast-moving consumer businesses, including meaningful leadership responsibility.
  • A strong personal design foundation, demonstrated through brand identity, packaging, visual systems and digital or physical consumer experiences.
  • A portfolio showing both hands-on design capability and senior creative leadership, with a clear explanation of what you created, directed and improved.
  • Experience activating or evolving established brand strategies across DTC, Amazon, retail and physical brand expression; CPG experience is strongly preferred.
  • Working fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, plus a practical understanding of packaging and production.
  • Experience with multi-brand portfolios, community, activations, partnerships, athletes or creators is a strong advantage.

Why join us

This is a high-visibility opportunity to shape two growing consumer brands at a company with real scale, ambition and appetite to move. The foundational work is in place; the canvas is now yours to bring to life, improve through evidence and extend across an evolving portfolio. If you want autonomy without isolation, high standards without corporate bureaucracy, and the chance to create work that matters both commercially and culturally, we would love to hear from you.

Application Process

  • Apply: Submit your resume + a brief note explaining why you’d crush it in this role.
  • Screen: TA team reviews for skills and cultural alignment.
  • Cultural + Behavioral: In this step, you will take a personality assessment to see how you will perform in the role, then review it on a call with a cultural specialist here.
  • Interview: Conversations with the hiring manager and team.
  • Final Round: Case study or work simulation (role-specific).
  • Decision & Offer: We move fast — typically within 2–4 weeks.

Compensation:

We believe in competing at a high level — and that includes how we approach pay. This is a remote-first role, open to candidates anywhere in the U.S. The expected base salary range for this position is [140,000-180,000] (USD). Your offer will reflect your experience, skill set, and where you live — we calibrate pay to ensure fairness and alignment with local markets. Beyond base pay, team members may be eligible for performance bonuses, growth incentives, and benefits built to support their health, wellness, and professional goals.

Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Principal Data Engineer to join our Datastore team. The Datastore sits at the heart of Beacon's platform. It defines our foundational data model and serves as the centralized repository and API for brain data collected from clinical studies, supporting the analytical tools, services, and applications used by our scientists, clinicians, and partners.

This role emphasizes the architecture and design of solutions spanning the Beacon Platform, with a focus on scalable data models to serve expanding business needs, event-driven pipelines, and engineering best practices. You will coach engineers and stakeholders of the Datastore on design patterns, collaborate with product and technical leads across platform and scientific teams, and help shape architectural direction and standards across Platform teams.

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs available located in Boston, New York and Paris. This role is fully remote working anywhere in the US.

What success looks like

  • You partner with engineering and product leaders and Datastore stakeholders to guide architecture and solutions for the Beacon Datastore, and influence architectural standards across Platform teams
  • You implement features that model best practices, and coach team members to develop their skills. You hold the Datastore to ever higher standards for data integrity, design soundness, and maintainability as it grows
  • You draft RFCs to lead complex feature discovery and technical design phases, soliciting and incorporating input and building alignment on the decisions that guide development

What you will bring

  • 10+ years of backend development experience, including significant experience focused on data engineering, data platforms, and infrastructure for data-centric applications
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, with production experience working with PostgreSQL
  • Proficiency with data streaming and event processing, using tools such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pulsar, or a cloud-based equivalent like Amazon Kinesis
  • Strong proficiency in a modern general-purpose language; proficiency in the Datastore's specific stack (SQL/TypeScript/Julia) is not required, but you should be able and excited to learn quickly!
  • Experience with, or interest in, using LLM-assisted or agentic coding tools in a production setting, with good judgment about what guardrails are needed
  • Experience deploying and operating services in containerized environments, with familiarity in Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and/or Helm
  • A collaborative mindset - you enjoy working across disciplines and believe people achieve more together than alone
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous and remote-friendly environments

We don't expect every candidate to check every box. If you bring strong fundamentals, care about data infrastructure for health, and are excited to learn, we’d love to hear from you!

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. Location: Remote (US)

Job Description

This is a high-impact commercial leadership role for someone who wants to shape how payers adopt clinical services, utilization management capabilities, and technology-enabled solutions. You will partner with senior leaders across payer organizations to solve complex operational and clinical challenges that influence cost, quality, member experience, and business performance.

Responsibilities

About the role:

  • Own and grow strategic payer relationships by helping clients adopt clinical services, utilization management capabilities, and technology-enabled solutions that improve performance across domain operations, clinical operations, and medical management.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, understand their priorities, and translate those priorities into high-value solutions that drive growth and long-term partnership.
  • Lead disciplined account management by aligning internal teams, driving executive business reviews, monitoring performance, resolving risks, and serving as a steady escalation point for clients and stakeholders.
  • Create growth by shaping solutions across clinical services, care management, utilization management, and technical capabilities, and by expanding into new business units, stakeholders, and strategic opportunities.
  • Partner closely with sales, operations, product, legal, and solutioning teams to turn complex client needs into compelling offerings and durable business results.

Qualifications

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • Deep experience in account management, business development, or strategic solution sales within healthcare, ideally with strong exposure to payer clinical operations, medical management, or domain operations.
  • A track record of creating and growing opportunities inside large, complex client organizations where trust, timing, and executive influence matter.
  • Success selling clinical services, utilization management, care management, or technology-enabled operational solutions to health plans and other payer organizations.
  • A clinical background is strongly preferred, especially RN licensure and nursing experience in utilization management, case management, or related payer-facing clinical functions.
  • A strong grasp of payer operating models and the ability to position analytics, software, platform-enabled services, and clinical operations solutions in a way that resonates with both business and clinical leaders.
  • Exceptional communication skills, strong commercial judgment, and the ability to bring structure and clarity to complex conversations.
  • Confidence operating with stakeholders at every level, including senior executives and CXO leaders.
  • An MBA or other advanced degree is a plus but not required if you bring strong relevant experience and domain credibility.

raw.description:
We Are Innovators & Category Creators

Clickatell, founded in Cape Town in 2000, was the first company to connect businesses with consumers via SMS using just four lines of code. Today, it powers AI-driven chat commerce for leading global brands across industries like banking, retail, telecoms, and healthcare. Over 25 years, Clickatell has led multiple industry firsts through its award-winning AI Chat Commerce Platform, enabling brands to connect, interact, and transact with customers seamlessly.

The Role

As a Research and Development Engineer: Innovation (Intermediate), you are a key driver of our R&D initiatives, responsible for taking ownership of complex features and technical challenges. You will collaborate with engineers and researchers to design and implement innovative solutions that enhance our SaaS platform. This role marks a transition into an "Independent Solver," where you are expected to navigate ambiguity and lead small "Tactical Pods" or projects from ideation to execution. You play a vital role in mentoring junior talent and graduates, ensuring our innovation efforts are modular, scalable, and aligned with the "Big Picture" of our systems architecture.

We Do The Right Things

Responsibilities of the Role

o Research and Analysis: Conduct in-depth research on industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitor products to identify opportunities for innovation.

o Idea Generation: Brainstorm, conceptualize, and propose innovative ideas and solutions that can improve our SaaS products.

o Prototyping: Develop proof-of-concept prototypes to test and validate new ideas, leveraging your technical skills.

o Collaborative Innovation: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software developers, designers, and product managers, to bring innovation projects to life.

o Documentation: Document research findings, design concepts, and development processes to maintain a clear and organized record of innovation efforts.

o Testing and Validation: Assist in testing and validation of new features, ensuring they meet the highest quality standards.

o Continuous Learning: Stay up-to-date with the latest technologies and best practices to contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

o Independent Solutioning: Take ownership of complex "Stories" and navigate ambiguity by figuring out how to build a solution from high-level requirements with minimal oversight.

o Feature Ownership & Integration: Manage the end-to-end development of specific features, ensuring that code is not only functional but modular, data-driven, and seamlessly integrates into the broader SaaS architecture.

o Technical Quality Assurance: Perform rigorous peer reviews and self-testing to ensure all delivered code is "Day 2" ready—meaning it is extendable, secure, and maintains system performance as it moves toward production readiness.

o Active Mentorship: Support the growth of Junior Engineers and Graduates by providing technical guidance on their tasks, performing constructive code reviews, and helping them navigate the department's "Way of Work."

We Are On A Learning Journey

Requirements of the Role

o Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

o Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, Java, or C++.

o A passion for innovation and a keen interest in emerging technologies.

o Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.

o Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team.

o Demonstrates Eagerness to learn, adapt, and take on new challenges.

o Knowledge of SaaS and cloud computing is essential.

o Minimum of 2–4 years of experience with a track record of "figuring out how to build it" and working alone.

o Experience taking ownership of a full "Story" from initial requirement to a functional, integrated feature.

o Ability to provide constructive code reviews and technical support to Junior engineers and Graduates.

o Good AI understanding and daily use in a responsible way.

A Bit About You

Behavioral competency requirements of a Highflyer:

o Team Player: Self-directed and dedicated team player who positively engages with the team to solve.

o Optimizing Processes: Optimally utilizes the tools and resources available to maximizes output. Conducts day-to-day operations using best practice to achieve effectiveness and accuracy. Continuously reviews and makes recommendations for process improvements.

o Expert Thinker: Equipped with specialist knowledge and makes recommendations that are practical, smart and ready to implement. Remains up-to-date in the industry and offers technical advice, and support to own team and others.

o Effective Problem-Solver: Resourceful, persistent, and creative when solving problems. Able to be analytical and follow a logical process to make decisions. Finds the balance between a good and quick decision through experience and knowledge. Able to present and explain thinking and the resulting decision.

o Connecting Collaboratively: Actively connects to bring cohesion and deliver excellence. Sees the value in working closely with different specialities and teams to ensure all operations are aligned to meet the required objectives.

o Maximizing Awareness: Recognizes emotions and how it affects behavior and relationships. Self-aware and picks up on emotional cues in situations. Self-manages and empowered to show initiative, follow through on commitments, and work well in a team. Listens, reflects, and responds effectively to constructive criticism.

o Enabling Strategy: Implements the action plans in order to produce practical outputs while considering the implication, and consequences for the organization and our customers.

o Action Orientated Mindset: Know-how to skilfully approach technical activities to deliver value. Eager to deliver new or improved solutions to drive the organization forward. Focused on what needs to be done and ensures follow-through on all commitments.

o Embracing Change: Invites change and stays focused and resilient, and chooses responses that are positive when feeling uncertain. Remains flexible, adaptable, and open to opportunities to be innovative. Uses failure as an opportunity to learn and grows. Thinks ahead, anticipates, and acts.

o Driving Delivery: Goal-oriented and monitors processes and systems to ensure tracking towards goals despite challenging and stressful situations. Sets high standards for quality and performance and provides metrics to show improvements as well as real-time variance for effective tracking.

Why You Should Join

Perks of the Role

o Medical Aid contribution

o Pension fund contribution

o Quarterly performance incentive bonus

o Risk benefit company contributions

o Reimbursable communications allowance for internet and mobile phone bills

o Half-day off on your birthday

o 5 personal days leave a year, over and above your annual leave

o Remote Working (our offices are currently open for essential use only due to COVID-19)

o Home office set-up with laptop, monitor and other related items.

Stronger Together

At Clickatell, Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of who we are - from how we build our product platforms to how we build our workforce. We believe that we are stronger together and by leveraging the power of diversity and inclusion, we are able to generate innovative ideas to revolutionize the way the world uses chat technology. We create common ground - Our platform is for all, and so is our workplace. Everyone is welcome at Clickatell and our employees feel psychologically safe and empowered to show up with their authentic selves at work.

raw.description:
Job Title: Full Stack Developer (AI-First)
Department: Engineering
Reports To: Engineering Lead
Location: Remote, CST
Compensation: Competitive salary based on experience

About Us:

We are a fast-growing, high-performance agency operating at the intersection of eCommerce, Amazon, growth, systems, and AI. Our team helps ambitious brands scale, and were increasingly focused on building internal tools, automation layers, intelligence systems, and AI-powered products that drastically improve business operations. We are not interested in using AI in a superficial way—were creating an AI-native agency model where intelligent systems enhance internal workflows, data visibility, decision-making, execution speed, and product capabilities.

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • Youre satisfied with maintaining old workflows or outdated methods.
  • You dont think about the future of AI and emerging tools.
  • You struggle to quickly learn new tools and technologies.
  • You prefer working in slow-moving, non-agile environments.
  • You dont enjoy building scalable, high-performance software.

This Role IS For You If:

  • Youre passionate about AI and building intelligent systems that drive real business impact.
  • Youre a builder who thrives on experimenting with new technologies and pushing boundaries.
  • Youre fluent in both frontend and backend development and excited by full-stack engineering.
  • You think in terms of leverage: automating processes, making workflows smarter, and using AI to increase output and decision-making.
  • You are a self-starter who takes ownership, moves fast, and is excited to work in a fast-paced, high-agency environment.

What Success Looks Like:

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Build Scalable Systems: Develop modern full-stack applications, covering frontend, backend, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Integrate AI: Use Claude Code and other AI tools to drive faster development and smarter workflows.
  • Prototype New Ideas: Experiment with new products and features, quickly prototyping and refining the best ideas into production systems.
  • Automate Workflows: Develop AI-first workflows and automation tools to eliminate repetitive tasks.
  • Collaborate with Leadership: Work closely with leadership to identify high-leverage areas where AI and software can have the biggest impact.

Your Responsibilities:

1. Full Stack Development

  • Frontend Development: Build modern, scalable front-end applications using frameworks like React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
  • Backend Development: Develop backend systems with Node.js, Python, and scalable system designs.
  • System Design: Design and implement APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure to power applications.

2. AI Integration

  • Claude Code Utilization: Use Claude Code extensively to speed up software development, including building, debugging, refactoring, and exploring architecture.
  • AI-First Tools: Build AI-powered utilities and tools that integrate seamlessly into business processes.

3. Product and System Innovation

  • Automation: Automate internal processes, including data workflows, and build agent-based systems to reduce manual work.
  • AI Copilots: Create AI assistants and intelligent interfaces that help internal and external users improve productivity.
  • Prototyping: Rapidly prototype new product ideas and features, then refine the most promising ones into production-ready systems.

4. Collaboration & Experimentation

  • Leadership Collaboration: Partner with leadership to identify opportunities where AI and software can create leverage and deliver value.
  • Tool and Model Experimentation: Stay on the cutting edge by experimenting with new AI models, tools, and frameworks.

What Were Looking For:

Required Skills & Traits:

  • Strong experience as a Full Stack Developer.
  • Experience with modern frontend tools like React, Next.js, TypeScript, or similar.
  • Strong backend experience using Node.js, Python, APIs, databases, and scalable system design.
  • Proficiency with Claude Code for building, debugging, and optimizing software.
  • A genuine obsession with AI, emerging tools, and the future of software development.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-moving team.
  • Ability to move quickly, take ownership, and solve complex problems with minimal direction.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models.
  • Familiarity with building agent frameworks, RAG, vector databases, or tool-calling systems.
  • Experience building internal platforms, analytics systems, or automation tools.
  • Startup or high-performance agency experience.
  • Experience shipping software quickly while maintaining high engineering standards.

Why This Role Is Different:

This is not a maintenance role. Its not for someone comfortable with slow-moving corporate environments or traditional development. This role is for someone who wants to help shape the future of an ambitious, AI-first company and play a key part in developing the products that come out of it. Youll have room to experiment, push ideas forward, and help define how AI truly integrates into a business with real momentum.

Application Process:

  1. Submit Your Application: Send your resume and a brief cover letter detailing your relevant experience.
  2. Assessment: If shortlisted, complete an assessment to showcase your technical skills and ability to think strategically.
  3. Interview: Candidates will go through 1-2 rounds of interviews to evaluate your full-stack development expertise, AI fluency, and problem-solving approach.

Ready to Shape the Future? Apply Now!

We are an equal opportunity employer and celebrate diversity in our workforce.

Recognized as an award-winning Oracle partner, we have delivered innovative solutions across Defense, Intelligence, Civilian, Health IT, and Tribal sectors. Our highly certified experts build systems that drive efficiency, accelerate modernization, and ensure mission outcomes with certainty.

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, paid life insurance, paid time off, 11 paid holidays, performance bonuses, tuition reimbursement, unlimited training, and the opportunity to thrive in a collaborative, flexible, and innovative environment.

For more information, visit .

About the role

Concept Plus is seeking an Oracle EBS Applications DBA to provide expert administration and support of Oracle E-Business Suite (R12.x) deployed on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Responsibilities include installation, configuration, patching, cloning, monitoring, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of EBS and supporting database technologies within a secure cloud environment. The ideal candidate has extensive experience supporting EBS and Oracle Databases in OCI and understands cloud architecture, networking, security, automation, and governance.

What you'll do

  • Administer, configure, and maintain Oracle E-Business Suite R12.x environments hosted on OCI, including application and database tiers.
  • Perform EBS patching, cloning, upgrades, and concurrent manager administration using Cloud-optimized workflows and tools.
  • Deploy and maintain OCI infrastructure components, including compute, block volumes, object storage, load balancers, OKE (optional), and networking services.
  • Implement and maintain backup, recovery, HA, and disaster recovery strategies using OCI Services, RMAN, Data Guard, and GI/RAC as applicable.
  • Monitor and tune database and EBS performance, including SQL optimization and OCI resource utilization.
  • Collaborate with cloud engineering, application development, and security teams to support interface requirements, workflow, and custom code deployments.
  • Ensure compliance with cloud security, identity governance, and regulatory requirements for the customer environment.
  • Create and maintain operational documentation, SOPs, architecture diagrams, and runbooks.

Qualifications

  • US Citizen with ability to obtain and/or maintain a US Government Public Trust.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field OR equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years experience as an Oracle Apps DBA supporting EBS R12.x.
  • Hands-on experience managing EBS in OCI, including deployment or migration.
  • Deep knowledge of:
    • Oracle Database (19c)
    • WebLogic / Oracle Application Server
    • Linux environments (Oracle Linux preferred)
    • SQL and PL/SQL tuning
  • Expertise with:
    • Patching and cloning (adpatch, adop, rapid clone)
    • RMAN, Data Guard, Gold Image management
    • OCI networking, IAM, Vault, Policies, Compute, and Storage services
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, and change management.
  • Experience with EBS lift-and-shift migrations to OCI or OCI-native EBS deployments.
  • Exadata Cloud Service or Autonomous Database experience required
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to collaborate within cross-functional and global teams
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask in high-pressure environments
  • Preferred experience with:
    • OCI-Resource Manager (Terraform)
    • Ansible, Shell scripting, Python
    • EBS modules such as Financials, HRMS, or Supply Chain
  • Preferred Certifications such as:
    • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Associate / Professional
    • Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) – DBA or EBS
    • Security+ or CISSP (if applicable based on customer requirements
  • Preferred exposure to other monitoring platforms (Dynatrace, New Relic, Splunk, AppDynamics, Zabbix, etc.)
